articles.title: UPSSSC ASO answer key 2026 released at upsssc.gov.in; objections open till August 2: Direct link to download here
articles.summary: The UPSSSC has published the provisional answer key for the Assistant Statistical Officer (ASO)/Assistant Research Officer (ARO) Mains Examination 2026 on its official website. Candidates who appeared for the July 26 exam can review their responses, estimate their scores, and raise objections online until August 2.

articles.title: UP PCS 2026 application deadline extended to August 3 for 500 vacancies; check details and direct link here
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission has extended the last date to apply for the UP PCS 2026 recruitment examination to August 3. The recruitment drive aims to fill 500 vacancies through the Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services Examination-2026.

articles.title: UPPSC GIC Lecturer result 2026 declared for all 13 subjects; main exam qualifiers announced: Check steps to download here
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has declared the UP GIC Lecturer Result 2026 for all 13 subjects on its official website. Candidates shortlisted in the preliminary examination have been selected for the Main exam.

articles.title: MHT CET final merit list 2026 releasing today; CAP choice filling to begin
articles.summary: MHT CET final merit list 2026: The Maharashtra State CET Cell will release the MHT CET final merit list 2026 today for BE and BTech admissions through CAP. The merit list has been prepared using MHT CET scores and Class 12 marks and will determine seat allotment along with candidates’ choices and seat availability.
